description: Configure the Facebook Photos Scraper to extract photo data from Facebook pages, profiles, albums, or individual photos.

newerThan.description: Only include photos posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Photos whose date couldn't be determined are always included. Leave empty for no lower bound.
newerThan.title: Only photos newer than

olderThan.description: Only include photos posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Photos whose date couldn't be determined are always included. Leave empty for no upper bound.
olderThan.title: Only photos older than

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration. Residential proxy is required and used by default: individual Facebook photo pages (the source of caption, timestamp, likes, comments, reactions, share count, and tagged people) return a login wall to datacenter/AUTO-tier IPs, so this actor defaults to the RESIDENTIAL proxy group for reliable results. Photo grid data (image URLs, alt text, author info) works without any proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

resultsLimit.description: Maximum number of photos to scrape. If not set, as many photos as possible are returned — typically dozens to around a hundred per Start URL, depending on how much Facebook loads for that page. This is a global cap across all Start URLs combined, not per URL — if an early URL alone reaches this limit, later URLs in the list won't be processed. To collect more photos overall, provide multiple album/set URLs or run the actor multiple times.
resultsLimit.title: Maximum number of results

startUrls.description: URLs of Facebook pages, profiles, albums, or individual photos to scrape. Supported formats: page URL (e.g., https://www.facebook.com/humansofnewyork), photos section URL (e.g., https://www.facebook.com/humansofnewyork/photos), individual photo URL (e.g., https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=123456), or album URL.

url.description: URL of a Facebook page, profile, album, or individual photo to scrape.
url.title: URL of a web page

startUrls.title: Facebook URLs

title: Facebook Photos Scraper Input
